nodes.name: Classify Time Window
nodes.notes: Business hours = Mon-Sat 09:00-18:00 IST. After-hours leads route to on-call rep.

nodes.name: Get On-Call Reps
nodes.notes: After-hours: GET /api/distributors/on-call — returns on-call rotation rep

nodes.name: Score & Pick Rep
nodes.notes: Scoring: +5 territory, +3 language, -1/active lead, +idle boost. Highest score wins.

parameters.jsonBody: ={"channel":"IN_APP","recipient":"{{ $('Score & Pick Rep').item.json.assignedRepId }}","template":"LEAD_ASSIGNED","context":{"leadName":"{{ $('Score & Pick Rep').item.json.leadFirstName }} {{ $('Score & Pick Rep').item.json.leadLastName }}","leadPhone":"{{ $('Score & Pick Rep').item.json.leadPhone }}","leadEmail":"{{ $('Score & Pick Rep').item.json.leadEmail }}","assignmentReason":"{{ $('Score & Pick Rep').item.json.assignmentReason }}","window":"{{ $('Score & Pick Rep').item.json.assignmentWindow }}","priority":"HIGH"}}

nodes.name: Escalate No-Rep to Ops
nodes.notes: Fallback: no reps available → alert Sales Ops for manual assignment

parameters.responseBody: ={"ok":true,"eventId":"{{ $('Verify HMAC Signature').item.json._meta.eventId }}","assignedTo":"{{ $('Score & Pick Rep').item.json.assignedRepId }}","window":"{{ $('Score & Pick Rep').item.json.assignmentWindow }}"}

meta.description: Distributes leads to sales team using: territory (state/region), language preference, workload (round-robin via scoring), and time of day (on-call rep after hours). After-hours window = Mon-Sat outside 09:00-18:00 IST.
